Investing.com -- Sprout Social began notifying employees on Tuesday about a workforce reduction that will eliminate approximately 260 positions, or 20% of its staff. The company’s board approved the restructuring plan on July 8, 2026. The social media management company said the plan aims to streamline its organizational structure and align costs with strategic priorities, including ongoing investments in AI-powered social intelligence. Sprout Social estimates it will incur pre-tax restructuring charges between $18.0 million and $20.0 million related to the workforce reduction.
